about: 5 bits of you giving the ball instructions while it's moving: 'hopefully I can get pretty close to the green on this one' → swing → 'oh don't go in that sand, motherf*cker' → 'yeah we're at the beach'; putting with the driver ('whatever works dude') → 'get in there, get in there'; 'this is for par' → putt → 'break in, break in'; 'anyway let's get on the green' → swing → 'get on the green, get on the green… boom boom'; ends on 'into the hole, into the hole' → full tee shot with tracer → 'not bad, not bad'. Every shot kept whole, swearing kept, no shirt wipes, no added text, even loudness (far-away lines lifted so they're clear), outfits alternate (no same shirt back to back). None of comp 1/2/3's bits reused. All cut from your true originals. Preview copy here; the real file is full quality.
